hook.headline_structure: Second-person aspirational regret framing ('You'll Wish You Went Jumbo') implying the larger size is the obvious better choice

angle: Size-up savings: buy the jumbo format of a bestselling body oil and save 16% while doubling your summer glow

offer.mechanic: Buy the jumbo size of Undaria Algae Body Oil to save 16% plus free shipping

visual.layout: Two pump bottles of the same product side by side, smaller on the left and larger on the right, with headline text above and a savings badge overlaid on the right bottle
visual.subject: OSEA Undaria Algae Body Oil in standard and jumbo sizes
visual.palette_mood: Warm golden amber with clean white accents on a neutral off-white background; bright and summery
visual.text_placement: Headline and subhead at top-center; savings badge mid-right overlaid on the larger bottle

objects.description: Main headline reading 'You'll Wish You Went Jumbo'
objects.persuasive_function: Hooks attention with aspirational regret framing to push the jumbo size
Reinforces the seasonal benefit and doubles-down on the glow promise

objects.description: OSEA Undaria Algae Body Oil standard-size pump bottle, smaller of the two, positioned on the left
objects.persuasive_function: Provides size comparison reference to make the jumbo bottle look like the obvious upgrade

objects.description: OSEA Undaria Algae Body Oil jumbo-size pump bottle, larger of the two, positioned on the right and slightly forward
objects.persuasive_function: The hero product being sold; its larger size visually justifies the offer

objects.description: Circular gold badge shape with dark border overlaid on the upper-right area of the jumbo bottle
objects.persuasive_function: Draws the eye to the savings claim and signals a deal

objects.description: Text inside the gold badge reading 'SAVE 16%'
objects.persuasive_function: States the discount value to create purchase incentive

background.light: Soft, even diffused light with no strong directional shadow, slightly warm

typography.case_treatment: Title case headline, sentence case subhead, all-caps savings badge
hierarchy_levels: medium bold sans-serif subhead below headline
bold sans-serif savings badge text mid-right

layout_detail.text_zone: Top third of frame for headline and subhead; mid-right for savings badge
layout_detail.frame_division: Upper text band over a single uninterrupted product display zone; no hard horizontal divisions
zone_positions: two product bottles mid-frame side by side
savings badge mid-right overlaid on larger bottle

target_audience: Existing or warm OSEA customers who already use or are considering the Undaria Algae Body Oil and are motivated by value
legibility_notes: Headline and subhead are large and clearly legible at feed size; product label text ('undaria algae body oil') is small and may be difficult to read at feed size but is not critical; savings badge text is bold and legible

signals: Product label explicitly reads 'undaria algae body oil'
Brand name OSEA visible on both bottles
Golden amber oil visible through translucent bottle
Ad copy references 'silky-soft skin all over' confirming body application
Controlled soft diffused studio lighting with no harsh shadows
Deliberate symmetrical product composition with intentional size contrast
Clean white tile backdrop is art-directed, not incidental
Precise typographic hierarchy with brand-consistent serif headline
No grain, blur, or handheld camera artefacts visible

creative_objective: Drive purchase of the jumbo size by anchoring a 16% saving and free shipping incentive
